_note: ATtiny13A 8-bit AVR MCU. Pin table audited against Microchip ATtiny13A datasheet (DS40002307). DIP-8 package. 1 KB flash, 64 B SRAM, 64 B EEPROM, 9.6 MHz internal RC. Port B only (PB0-PB5). PB5 = RESET (active low, fuse-selectable as GPIO/ADC0). PB3 = ADC3, PB4 = ADC2, PB2 = ADC1/INT0/T0, PB5 = ADC0 (if RSTDISBL fused). 4-channel 10-bit ADC. Timer0 8-bit (OC0A on PB0, OC0B on PB1). Analog comparator: AIN0 on PB0, AIN1 on PB1. Pin names match bw-board terminal spelling contract: lowercase pXn.
